description: Step 3 of the content pipeline. Use once a job has a flattened rough cut (outputs/.roughcut.mp4) and needs on-screen graphics — plans the video beat by beat BEFORE building anything, then builds the HyperFrames composition as short seamless parts on one shared timeline. Covers both 9:16 short-form and 16:9 long-form. Delegates actual HyperFrames HTML authoring to the vendor hyperframes-core / hyperframes-creative / hyperframes-animation / hyperframes-registry skills already installed in .claude/skills/ — this skill enforces the pipeline-specific discipline around them (plan-first, safe zones, part-based rendering, version pinning).
